title: HTDT Capture Reference-Object Asset Manifest v1
description: App-bundle provenance manifest for shipped .referenceobject assets (issue #268), loaded from ReferenceObjects/manifest.json. Records per asset: stable id + revision, artifact digest, source USDZ identity/digest, intended physical binding, measured dimensions + scale-validation method, Create ML/Xcode toolchain, training mode, viewing-angle config, negative-example set, session roles, optional marker-to-equipment rigid transform with calibration source, and license provenance. A retrained artifact is a new revision — old evidence is never reinterpreted against a retrained asset. Mission INPUT, not capture output.

assets.description: Shipped assets. Unique on asset_id; the app enforces a per-mission selection cap of 10 configured objects.

viewing_angle_config.description: Free-text record of the createml viewing-angle flags used (e.g. 'upright', 'all-angles').

referenceobject_strip_usdz.description: Whether REFERENCEOBJECT_STRIP_USDZ stripped the embedded USDZ from the shipped artifact.

t_marker_from_equipment.description: Column-major rigid transform, marker frame from equipment frame.

asset_id.description: Stable slug — survives retraining; only revision advances.

arkit_object_name.description: Value assigned to ARReferenceObject.name — the runtime match key from ARObjectAnchor back to this entry.

artifact_filename.description: File inside ReferenceObjects/. Must end in .referenceobject — legacy .arobject cannot mix with .referenceobject in one session.

physical_binding.description: Declaration of the physical object this asset stands for — manifest intent only, never equipment identity.
